- ja: 再現ケースが基準で既に合格しています（外れを再現していません）。ケースを見直してください。

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 17 §1.6 gate 2, §5.4 (ADR-0034): a case of kind `reproduction` passes every run in the baseline. A reproduction case must be red before the fix (red → green); one green already proves nothing. The check is `failure`.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The summary lists the case under the findings with `case_not_reproducing`; the worker logs `forge.ai_eval.check_written` with `error_code=FG-AIASSET-0006` and `pipeline_id`.

## 対処 (fix)

Rewrite the case so it reproduces the miss on the current assets (it fails in the baseline), or make it `regular` if it is a plain regression case.
